about.title: San Bernardino Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Nobody plans for the phone call that changes everything. In 2025, San Bernardino recorded 32 traffic deaths, along with 1,380 injury collisions on streets like E Highland Avenue and W Baseline Street and on SR-210 and I-215. Behind each of those numbers is a household in San Bernardino County trying to figure out what comes next. A wrongful death claim is one part of that. It is a civil action, completely separate from any criminal case, and it exists so a family can recover funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and compensation for the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. California limits who may bring the claim, starting with a spouse or domestic partner and children, and the deadline is generally two years from the date of death, with a shorter window when a public agency is involved. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm. We listen, then connect you with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why San Bernardino Families Reach Out to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California gives standing first to a spouse or domestic partner and children, and only then to certain dependents or heirs. An attorney can sort out where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: The deadline is tracked from day one
items.desc: Most claims must be brought within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a government entity is involved. Getting connected early keeps those dates from slipping.

items.title: Every category of loss is counted
items.desc: Funeral and burial costs, the income and support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their companionship and guidance are all recoverable. The attorney you are matched with works on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: Our family member was killed in a crash on I-215 in San Bernardino. Does it matter that a road agency might be involved?
items.answer: It can matter a great deal. When a public entity such as a state or county road agency may share responsibility, California requires a formal claim on a much shorter timeline than the usual two years. An attorney can evaluate whether that applies to your situation and act on it quickly.

items.question: The driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and moves separately from any criminal prosecution. Families often pursue both at the same time, and the outcome of one does not decide the other.

items.question: What does it cost to use LawProactive and then hire an attorney?
items.answer: Our service is free, and we are not a law firm. The independent attorney we connect you with handles wrongful death cases on contingency, meaning there is no fee unless there is a recovery. You can ask about the specific terms before agreeing to anything.
